title: Detailed strawberry
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bodyGrad' cx='45%' cy='40%' r='65%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b7a'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#e8384f'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b81e35'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9aa5' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff9aa5' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- soft glow behind berry -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='40' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- main strawberry body -->
  <path d='M50 22 C68 22 84 34 86 52 C88 70 74 88 50 92 C26 88 12 70 14 52 C16 34 32 22 50 22 Z'
        fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>

  <!-- lighter left highlight -->
  <path d='M28 40 C22 50 24 68 34 78 C30 66 30 50 36 40 Z'
        fill='#ff9aa5' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- seeds -->
  <g fill='#ffd98a'>
    <ellipse cx='38' cy='34' rx='2.2' ry='3' transform='rotate(-15 38 34)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='31' rx='2.2' ry='3'/>
    <ellipse cx='62' cy='35' rx='2.2' ry='3' transform='rotate(15 62 35)'/>
    <ellipse cx='30' cy='46' rx='2.2' ry='3' transform='rotate(-10 30 46)'/>
    <ellipse cx='44' cy='44' rx='2.2' ry='3'/>
    <ellipse cx='57' cy='44' rx='2.2' ry='3'/>
    <ellipse cx='70' cy='47' rx='2.2' ry='3' transform='rotate(10 70 47)'/>
    <ellipse cx='36' cy='58' rx='2.2' ry='3'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='57' rx='2.2' ry='3'/>
    <ellipse cx='64' cy='58' rx='2.2' ry='3'/>
    <ellipse cx='27' cy='62' rx='2.2' ry='3' transform='rotate(-8 27 62)'/>
    <ellipse cx='73' cy='62' rx='2.2' ry='3' transform='rotate(8 73 62)'/>
    <ellipse cx='42' cy='70' rx='2.2' ry='3'/>
    <ellipse cx='58' cy='70' rx='2.2' ry='3'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='81' rx='2' ry='2.8'/>
    <ellipse cx='34' cy='72' rx='2' ry='2.8' transform='rotate(-8 34 72)'/>
    <ellipse cx='66' cy='72' rx='2' ry='2.8' transform='rotate(8 66 72)'/>
  </g>

  <!-- seed shadows for depth -->
  <g fill='#c2505f' opacity='0.5'>
    <ellipse cx='39' cy='35' rx='2.2' ry='3' transform='rotate(-15 39 35)'/>
    <ellipse cx='51' cy='32' rx='2.2' ry='3'/>
    <ellipse cx='63' cy='36' rx='2.2' ry='3' transform='rotate(15 63 36)'/>
    <ellipse cx='45' cy='45' rx='2.2' ry='3'/>
    <ellipse cx='51' cy='58' rx='2.2' ry='3'/>
    <ellipse cx='43' cy='71' rx='2.2' ry='3'/>
  </g>

  <!-- calyx leaves -->
  <g fill='#3fa34d'>
    <path d='M50 26 C44 16 30 12 22 18 C30 20 36 26 40 30 Z'/>
    <path d='M50 26 C56 16 70 12 78 18 C70 20 64 26 60 30 Z'/>
    <path d='M50 24 C46 12 38 8 32 10 C38 16 42 22 46 28 Z' fill='#5cc26a'/>
    <path d='M50 24 C54 12 62 8 68 10 C62 16 58 22 54 28 Z' fill='#5cc26a'/>
  </g>

  <!-- stem -->
  <path d='M49 24 C48 16 50 10 52 6 C54 10 55 16 54 24 Z' fill='#2e8b3e'/>
  <path d='M50 22 C50 16 51 11 52 8' stroke='#6fd97f' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
